{"notes": "Visit 3 (ended 4:15). Board: the belly line is dark and connected from the start through the tail curl. The back line is now fully drawn, arching from the nose to about x~23 and up the tail fork, but it is still pale, so it is not connected and would not fall as it stands. The remaining gap is at the nose, where it meets the start. The earlier concern about the crowded tail cluster (x~24-25) is still open, because the back line's far end also stops short of the dark chain near x~23-24. About 5-6 minutes remain. I can't tell who placed which dominoes, so I'm not crediting or blaming anyone for specific pieces.

Sofia: Spoke at 3:30, 3:45 and 4:00. She correctly spotted the nose gap and told Jack to keep going on the top and not redo it, which is good diagnosis and direction. But her three updates were nearly identical (found it, looking closely, bridging), and the gap is still open at 4:15. I haven't seen the bridge land, so execution is unproven. Ask what is blocking her, and check whether she is placing dominoes or only narrating.

Jack: Silent. The back line has grown a lot, and Sofia credits him with the top line, but I didn't see him place anything. Still unconfirmed.

Hana: Silent this visit. I haven't confirmed that the tail dry run she proposed happened. Ask.

Omar: Silent this visit. Check whether the upper tail fork (pale, x~26-28) will join the back line and the dark chain.

Next visit: is the nose joined, does the tail join hold, and who fixed what?"}
